title: Rito Leri Hlanganiseke Tintshava
intro: Moya-xiviri wo lulama a wu nyikiwa tinyiko leti nga tolovelekangiki leti humaka ematilweni, wu va mufumi ni nhenha leyi ntumbuluko wa yona a wu vonaka wu hlanganisiwe ni ntumbuluko hi woxe. Mhaka ya vona yi luka hi vuprofeta, vuhosi, na vutshila, yi siya ndzhaka leyi twala eka matluka ya nhlavutelo ya Xikwembu.
clues: Ndzi hlawuriwile tanihi nandza wa Allah naswona ndzi nyikiwe mfumo wa matimba exikarhi ka vanhu lava hlawuriweke.
Tintshava ni swinyenyana a swi ta twala na mina eku dzuniseni ka La nge Henhla-henhla.
Nsimbi yi ve yo olova ku fana ni vumba emavokweni ya mina, hi ku navela ka Allah ntsena.
Ndzi endle swisirhelelo swo sirhelela leswi a swi sirhelela tinhenha loko ku hisa nyimpi.
Ndzi tshame ndzi hundza ndzingo wo tika loko vanhu vambirhi lava kanetaka va nghena endhawini ya mina ya vugandzeri swi nga swi langutelanga.
Ndzi boxiwa etlhelo ka mufumi loyi a a lerisa moya ni jinn — hikuva mufumi yoloye a a ri n’wana wa mina.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Vakaneti vambirhi va nghene endhawini ya mina ya vugandzeri
Ndzi langutane ni ndhambi leyikulu leyi loviseke vanhu va mina

U ringetiwile hi ku lahlekeriwa hi ndyangu hinkwawo na rifuwo

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka

Nhonga leyi hundzukeke nyoka
Ntanga wo hlamarisa lowu nga ni mixaka yimbirhi ya swibyariwa

location.answer: Nsimbi yi endliwe yi olova emavokweni ya mina

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: U amukele Tipisalema (Zabur) ivi a simekiwa tanihi mufumi la lulameke
Ku ponisiwa ekhwirini ra nhlampfi naswona vanhu va pfumerile
U kutsule vanhu va mina emavokweni ya mufumi wa tihanyi
Ku nyikiwe vulawuri ehenhla ka moya ni jinn
U vuyisiwile eka rihanyo naswona u nyikiwe mikateko leyi engetelekeke swinene
outcome.answer: U amukele Tipisalema (Zabur) ivi a simekiwa tanihi mufumi la lulameke

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
